source.license_note: Facts extracted from OPM opm-simulators source files that are GPL-3.0-or-later (Copyright Equinor and OPM contributors): keyword names, item numbers, allowed values and messages. The C++ files are not copied here.

item_numbering: 1-based, as in the ECLIPSE manual and OPM KeywordValidation
rule_semantics: A rule applies only to an item with an explicit, non-defaulted value. allow: the value must be in the list (an empty list means the item must be defaulted). expr: a Python expression in v that must be true.

AIM.message: Flow only supports the fully implicit method and will use it instead

COORDSYS.message: Multiple grid systems not supported, COORDSYS is ignored.

IMPES.message: Flow only supports the fully implicit method and will use it instead

LICENSES.message: Flow does not check out licences, LICENSES is ignored

PETGRID.message: OPM Flow cannot read GSG format grid input, re-export case from Petrel using GRDECL instead.
